Each alert must have a linked runbook, a positive-control activation and a verified recovery/clear event without secret payloads. External paging and deployed observation remain release gates."

An exercised alert with a positive-control activation and a verified recovery/clear event is REPOSITORY-TECHNICAL and is required for internal technical completion. Only external paging and deployed observation are carved out as release gates. So the external half is correctly out of scope, and the internal half is in scope and unmet.
